title: Heuristics update: factor family durability + latent regime detection concept
rationale: Two generalizable lessons from tonight's scan: (1) Range and volatility factor families are the most OOS-durable on US equities; trend factors decay fastest. This guides factor mining bias in R33 and beyond. (2) Pre-crash 'latent build-up' is a detectable regime state preceding stress — conceptually distinct from current-stress detection. Important to track this distinction in any regime stack design.
content:
### Factor family durability on US equities (Hubble, arXiv:2604.09601)
- LESSON: Range and volatility factor families are the most OOS-durable on US equities (HAC-significant IC through 2025-2026 holdout). Trend/momentum factor families decay fastest (weakest IS trend collapses OOS). When mining or selecting factors for US equities, bias toward range and volatility families.
- LESSON: Family-aware selection prevents intra-family crowding: after applying a correlation diversity filter (|corr|<0.70), ensure each factor family (range, vol, trend, reversal, volume) is represented. Otherwise volatility factors alone dominate the pool despite their pairwise corr being just below threshold.
- LESSON: Dual-channel RAG (positive examples = high-IC factors to replicate + negative examples = structured failure records to avoid) outperforms positive-only seeding. Combine with Epistemic Autopsy failure JSON pool (arXiv:2604.11477) as the negative channel.
- WHEN: R33 QuantaAlpha seed construction, any LLM-driven factor mining round. Use range/vol family examples as positive RAG seed. Use Epistemic Autopsy failures as negative RAG seed.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2604.09601 (Hubble, April 2026). US ~500 stocks, OOS 2025-06 to 2026-03.

### Latent build-up phase precedes market stress — detect BEFORE onset
- LESSON: Market stress regimes are preceded by a detectable 'latent build-up' phase where depth erosion and microstructure entropy rise before price impact occurs. The classical regime detection (HMM, VIX, RMT gap) triggers AT or AFTER stress onset. True early warning requires monitoring the buildup phase signals.
- LESSON: In LOB data, depth erosion (market makers quietly withdrawing) and HMM entropy (rising ambiguity in state transitions) are the dominant pre-crash signals, driving >99% of early detections with positive lead times. Current R35 stack signals (RMT gap, Wasserstein HMM) are concurrent or lagging.
- LESSON: Daily yfinance proxies for depth erosion are experimental and unvalidated: High-Low/Close spread expansion + HMM state posterior entropy rise. These require explicit backtesting before deployment.
- WHEN: R35 regime stack design; any strategy requiring pre-emptive position reduction before stress onset (PEAD, pairs). Flag as 'level-2 data required' until a LOB feed is secured.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2604.20949 (Hiremath & Hiremath, April 2026). GitHub: prakulhiremath/LOB-Latent-Regimes.
